capability: Label each note by kind; fit it where it belongs
title: Give every note a label.

hook.picture: Close on the whale dropping two near-identical grey cards, an old draft and the final decision, into one huge pasted card on the line.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It quoted our old draft like it was the decision.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: project lead reading the AI summary on Monday

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: dozens of grey cards on the line, drafts and decisions side by side with no difference. Three more look-alike pairs drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the pod grabs the wrong one.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each note shows up looking the same.

stakes.body: A decision gets reversed in front of the client, and the team stops trusting the summary.

solution_hint: Label each note by what it is.

metaphor.body: Notes are cards that all look the same until each gets a coloured tab for its kind; the brief is a tree of sockets that only takes the right kind in each slot.

steps.picture: The cards freeze and tabs colour in: yellow tab for draft, slate tab for decided, umber tab for rule.
steps.sound: Three tuned wooden clicks, one per colour

steps.picture: A tree of sockets hangs from the line; each socket shows the tab colour it accepts.
steps.words: Label it: draft, decided, or rule.

steps.picture: A slate decided card glides into the slate socket and snaps; a small tick appears at the joint.
Push-in: the whale nudges the yellow draft card at the decided socket; it is refused at the joint, a copper cross, a small shake, and it drops back.
steps.words: A draft cannot fill a decision slot.
steps.sound: The click, muffled and a half-step flat

steps.picture: The umber rule card drops into its own socket at the top of the tree; receipts tick up the branches.
The tree settles; every card shows its tab.
steps.words: Labelled cards that fit slots: atoms.

real_case.claim: Context Atoms first three jobs (16 Oct 2026): 3 prompts and 41, 26 and 41 atoms, all GREEN; 9 atoms shared by all three (the spine), to be verified first.

honest_limit.picture: A slate decided card snaps into the decided socket and gets its receipt, but the words inside it carry a copper smudge: someone labelled a wrong date as decided.
honest_limit.words: A wrong label still fits the slot.

not_this.body: Labels catch mix-ups, not wrong facts.

ending_pattern.body: The same two look-alike cards return in the FELT framing, now tabbed yellow and slate. The pod reaches in; only the slate socket opens to it, the draft drifts aside, and its answer chip shows a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: In bar 2 the pod quoted the draft; now the draft cannot reach the pod at all, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Say what each piece is before you send.
